---
title: "Buffy"
output:
  html_document:
    css: styles.css
    theme: flatly
---

```{r slideshow, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
photos <- list.files("buffy_photos",
                     pattern = "\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|JPG|JPEG|PNG|GIF)$",
                     full.names = FALSE)

if (length(photos) == 0) {
  cat('<p class="text-center" style="margin-top:3em; color:#8b5e5e;">
        No photos found yet — add images to the <code>buffy_photos</code> folder!
      </p>')
} else {
  cat('<div class="slideshow-wrapper">\n')
  cat('  <div id="buffyCarousel" class="carousel slide" data-ride="carousel" data-interval="2500">\n')
  cat('    <div class="carousel-inner">\n')
  for (i in seq_along(photos)) {
    active <- if (i == 1) " active" else ""
    cat(sprintf('      <div class="item%s">\n', active))
    cat(sprintf('        <img src="buffy_photos/%s" class="slideshow-img" alt="Buffy photo %d">\n', photos[i], i))
    cat('      </div>\n')
  }
  cat('    </div>\n')
  cat('    <a class="left carousel-control" href="#buffyCarousel" role="button" data-slide="prev">\n')
  cat('      <span class="glyphicon glyphicon-chevron-left" aria-hidden="true"></span>\n')
  cat('    </a>\n')
  cat('    <a class="right carousel-control" href="#buffyCarousel" role="button" data-slide="next">\n')
  cat('      <span class="glyphicon glyphicon-chevron-right" aria-hidden="true"></span>\n')
  cat('    </a>\n')
  cat('  </div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```
